title: aldama tenuifolia
intro: Aldama tenuifolia, commonly known as Mexican tea or yerba de la reina, is a perennial plant in the Rosaceae family, native to Mexico and Central America. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, colds, and inflammation, due to its health benefits which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Aldama tenuifolia include modulating the immune system, reducing inflammation, and acting as an antioxidant, which contributes to its potential in treating conditions such as arthritis and other inflammatory diseases. The bioactive constituents of Aldama tenuifolia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
